title: Sticky context bar
description: The top of a list page that stays while the rows scroll under it: SearchPill, then FilterChipRow (PhoneFilterBar on phones), then ResultLine. An opaque STICKY_TOOLBAR strip, below the safe area on phones. The title row with the page's action (PageTitle actions) sits above it and scrolls away.
when: A list, grid or table page with a search and filters people change while they scroll (customers, suppliers, products).
In place of a SubpageToolbar when the page needs the wide search and the chip row.

instead.need: A page with one or two filters and a few actions
The page's create action and refresh

a11y: With label it is a search landmark (role=search) named for the page, so screen-reader users jump to it.
Its children keep their own names; the result line announces the new count.
notes: One per page, right under the page heading: PageTitle with `actions` (the page's one primary or secondary + RefreshButton) or TextTabs. The page's actions stay on that title row, never in this bar (it holds search, filters and the result line only).
Desktop and iPad show FilterChipRow (max-md:hidden on the phone bar's sibling), phones PhoneFilterBar (md:hidden): same filters, same state.

The page's views (Đang mở · Đã đóng · Tất cả) are Pills in FilterChipRow `leading` on md+ and PhoneFilterBar `typeItems` (radio items) on phones: same state, usually a plain param (?view=) written with useFilterParams().setParams. The default view may be other than “all”; leave it out of the URL.
Phone chrome: at most 2 rows plus the result line, under 25% of the viewport (P1).
